title: Show HN: Run an 80B Qwen in 4.3 GB of RAM on a Mac, and a 35B on an iPhone
summary: Swiftlet enables running large language models like 80B Qwen on a Mac with only 4.3 GB RAM and 35B on an iPhone, likely via aggressive quantization and efficient inference. It targets edge deployment, making high-parameter models accessible on consumer hardware.
